{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgPNyMbSJxAMw6fukbCwg","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01QHg87tC3KbZ9SJhBqT67QA","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DupFind/runs/20261025.174005/build/DupFind/internal/walk/walk.go","content":"// Package walk traverses a directory tree and yields eligible regular files.\npackage walk\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n\t\"io/fs\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"sort\"\n)\n\n// Entry is a regular file eligible for duplicate detection.\ntype Entry struct {\n\tPath string // relative to root, \"/\" separated, no leading \"./\"\n\tSize int64\n}\n\n// Files walks root recursively and returns every regular file whose size is at least minSize.\n// Symbolic links are neither followed nor reported, so a directory reachable only through a link\n// is not traversed. Zero-byte files are never returned. A subdirectory that cannot be read yields\n// one line on warn and is skipped. File contents are never opened.\nfunc Files(root string, minSize int64, warn io.Writer) ([]Entry, error) {\n\tvar entries []Entry\n\terr := filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tif path == root {\n\t\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(warn, \"dupfind: warning: cannot read directory %s: %v\\n\", path, err)\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tif d.IsDir() || !d.Type().IsRegular() {\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tinfo, err := d.Info()\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(warn, \"dupfind: warning: cannot stat %s: %v\\n\", Package walk traverses a directory tree and yields eligible regular files.\npackage walk\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n\t\"io/fs\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"sort\"\n)\n\n// Entry is a regular file eligible for duplicate detection.\ntype Entry struct {\n\tPath string // relative to root, \"/\" separated, no leading \"./\"\n\tSize int64\n}\n\n// Files walks root recursively and returns every regular file whose size is at least minSize.\n// Symbolic links are neither followed nor reported, so a directory reachable only through a link\n// is not traversed. Zero-byte files are never returned. A subdirectory that cannot be read yields\n// one line on warn and is skipped. File contents are never opened.\nfunc Files(root string, minSize int64, warn io.Writer) ([]Entry, error) {\n\tvar entries []Entry\n\terr := filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tif path == root {\n\t\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(warn, \"dupfind: warning: cannot read directory %s: %v\\n\", path, err)\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tif d.IsDir() || !d.Type().IsRegular() {\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tinfo, err := d.Info()\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(warn, \"dupfind: warning: cannot stat %s: %v\\n\", path, err)\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tif info.Size() == 0 || info.Size() < minSize {\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\t\trel, err := filepath.Rel(root, path)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tentries = append(entries, Entry{Path: filepath.ToSlash(rel), Size: info.Size()})\n\t\treturn nil\n\t})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Path < entries[j].Path })\n\treturn entries, nil\n}\n"}}}

File contents are not read.\nfunc GroupBySize(entries []walk.Entry) [][]walk.Entry {\n\tbySize := make(map[int64][]walk.Entry)\n\tfor _, e := range entries {\n\t\tbySize[e.Size] = append(bySize[e.Size], e)\n\t}\n\tsizes := make([]int64, 0, len(bySize))\n\tfor size, bucket := range bySize {\n\t\tif len(bucket) >= 2 {\n\t\t\tsizes = append(sizes, size)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(sizes, func(i, j int) bool { return sizes[i] < sizes[j] })\n\tbuckets := make([][]walk.Entry, 0, len(sizes))\n\tfor _, size := range sizes {\n\t\tbuckets = append(buckets, bySize[size])\n\t}\n\treturn buckets\n}\n\n// GroupByDigest hashes the files of each size bucket with SHA-256 and returns a group for every\n// digest shared by two or more files. A file that cannot be read yields one line on warn and is\n// excluded from grouping. Files are opened read-only.\nfunc GroupByDigest(root string, buckets [][]walk.Entry, warn io.Writer) []Group {\n\tvar groups []Group\n\tfor _, bucket := range buckets {\n\t\tbyDigest := make(map[string][]string)\n\t\tfor _, e := range bucket {\n\t\t\tdigest, err := digestFile(filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(e.Path)))\n\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(warn, \"dupfind: warning: cannot read %s: %v\\n\", e.Path, err)\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tbyDigest[digest] = append(byDigest[digest], e.Path)\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor digest, paths := range byDigest {\n\t\t\tif len(paths) >= 2 {\n\t\t\t\tgroups = append(groups, Group{Size: bucket[0].Size, Digest: digest, Paths: paths})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn groups\n}\n\n// Order sorts paths within each group by byte value, orders groups by reclaimable bytes\n// descending and then by digest ascending, and numbers the groups from 1.\nfunc Order(groups []Group) []Group {\n\tfor i := range groups {\n\t\tsort.Strings(groups[i].Paths)\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(groups, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\tri, rj := groups[i].Reclaimable(), groups[j].Reclaimable()\n\t\tif ri != rj {\n\t\t\treturn ri > rj\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn groups[i].Digest < groups[j].Digest\n\t})\n\tfor i := range groups {\n\t\tgroups[i].Number = i + 1\n\t}\n\treturn groups\n}\n\n// digestFile returns the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the file at path.\nfunc digestFile(path string) (string, error) {\n\tf, err := os.Open(path)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", err\n\t}\n\tdefer f.Close()\n\th := sha256.New()\n\tif _, err := io.Copy(h, f); i < len(s); i++ {\n\t\tif s[i] < '0' || s[i] > '9' {\n\t\t\treturn 0, invalid\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tn, err := strconv.ParseInt(s, 10, 64)\n\tif err != nil || n < 1 {\n\t\treturn 0, invalid\n\t}\n\treturn n, nil\n}\n\n// validateDirectory confirms that dir names an existing directory and returns its path with\n// symbolic links resolved, so that a link to a directory can be walked.\nfunc validateDirectory(dir string) (string, error) {\n\tinfo, err := os.Stat(dir)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", err\n\t}\n\tif !info.IsDir() {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"%s is not a directory\", dir)\n\t}\n\tresolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(dir)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", err\n\t}\n\treturn resolved, nil\n}\n\n// errNoDirectory is returned by parseArgs when no directory is given; Standard output carries only CSV.\nfunc Run(args []string, stdout, stderr io.Writer) int {\n\tcfg, err := parseArgs(args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"dupfind: %v; %s\\n\", err, usage)\n\t\treturn 2\n\t}\n\troot, err := validateDirectory(cfg.Dir)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"dupfind: %v\\n\", err)\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tentries, err := walk.Files(root, cfg.MinSize, stderr)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"dupfind: %v\\n\", err)\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tgroups := dupes.Order(dupes.GroupByDigest(root, dupes.GroupBySize(entries), stderr))\n\twrite := report.WriteListing\n\tif cfg.Summary {\n\t\twrite = report.WriteSummary\n\t}\n\tif err := write(stdout, groups); err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"dupfind: %v\\n\", err)\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// parseArgs interprets [--summary] [--min-size <bytes>] <directory>. Options must precede the\n// directory; any other positional argument counts toward the single-directory requirement.\nfunc parseArgs(args []string) (Config, error) {\n\tfs := flag.NewFlagSet(\"dupfind\", flag.ContinueOnError)\n\tfs.SetOutput(io.Discard)\n\tvar cfg Config\n\tfs.BoolVar(&cfg.Summary, \"summary\", false, \"\")\n\tminSize := fs.String(\"min-size\", \"1\", \"\")\n\tif err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {\n\t\treturn Config{}, err\n\t}\n\tif fs.NArg() != 1 {\n\t\treturn Config{}, fmt.Errorf(\"expected exactly one directory argument, got %d\", fs.NArg())\n\t}\n\tn, err := parseMinSize(*minSize)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn Config{}, err\n\t}\n\tcfg.MinSize = n\n\tcfg.Dir = fs.Arg(0)\n\treturn cfg, nil\n}\n\n// parseMinSize accepts only a string of ASCII decimal digits whose value is at least 1 and fits\n// in an int64. Signs, zero, hexadecimal, exponent forms, and overflow are rejected.\nfunc parseMinSize(s string) (int64, error) {\n\tinvalid := fmt.Errorf(\"--min-size must be a positive decimal integer, got %q\", s)\n\tif s == \"\" {\n\t\treturn 0, invalid\n\t}\n\tfor i := 0; i < len(s); i++ {\n\t\tif s[i] < '0' || s[i] > '9' {\n\t\t\treturn 0, invalid\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tn, err := strconv.ParseInt(s, 10, 64)\n\tif err != nil || n < 1 {\n\t\treturn 0, invalid\n\t}\n\treturn n, nil\n}\n\n// validateDirectory confirms that dir names an existing directory and returns its path with\n// symbolic links resolved, so that a link to a directory can be walked.\nfunc validateDirectory(dir string) (string, error) {\n\tinfo, err := os.Stat(dir)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", err\n\t}\n\tif !info.IsDir() {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"%s is not a directory\", dir)\n\t}\n\tresolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(dir)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", err\n\t}\n\treturn resolved, nil\n}\n\n// errNoDirectory is returned by parseArgs when no directory is given; kept distinct for tests.\nvar _ = errors.New\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":2,"oldLines":10,"newStart":2,"newLines":117,"lines":[" // validation, pipeline orchestration, and exit codes."," package cli"," ","-import \"io\"","+import (","+  \"errors\"","+  \"flag\"","+  \"fmt\"","+  \"io\"","+  \"os\"","+  \"path/filepath\"","+  \"strconv\""," ","+  \"dupfind/internal/dupes\"","+  \"dupfind/internal/report\"","+  \"dupfind/internal/walk\"","+)","+","+// Config is the parsed command line.","+type Config struct {","+  Summary bool","+  MinSize int64","+  Dir     string","+}","+","+const usage = \"usage: dupfind [--summary] [--min-size <bytes>] <directory>\"","+"," // Run executes dupfind with args and returns the process exit code: 0 on success,"," // 1 on operational failure, 2 on usage error. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a9d4fcb3-5ed6-4260-a2c0-1654cde25014","uuid":"5e01bffe-9962-4d74-934b-e21ace6adc43","timestamp":"2026-10-25T17:52:35.640Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DupFind/runs/20261025.174005/build/DupFind/internal/cli/cli.go","oldString":"\treturn resolved, nil\n}\n\n// errNoDirectory is returned by parseArgs when no directory is given; kept distinct for tests.\nvar _ = errors.New\n","newString":"\treturn resolved, nil\n}\n","originalFile":"// Package cli implements the dupfind command line: argument parsing, directory\n// validation, pipeline orchestration, and exit codes.\npackage cli\n\nimport (\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"flag\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"strconv\"\n\n\t\"dupfind/internal/dupes\"\n\t\"dupfind/internal/report\"\n\t\"dupfind/internal/walk\"\n)\n\n// Config is the parsed command line.\ntype Config struct {\n\tSummary bool\n\tMinSize int64\n\tDir     string\n}\n\nconst usage = \"usage: dupfind [--summary] [--min-size <bytes>] <directory>\"\n\n// Run executes dupfind with args and returns the process exit code: 0 on success,\n// 1 on operational failure, 2 on usage error. Standard output carries only CSV.\nfunc Run(args []string, stdout, stderr io.Writer) int {\n\tcfg, err := parseArgs(args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"dupfind: %v; %s\\n\", err, usage)\n\t\treturn 2\n\t}\n\troot, err := validateDirectory(cfg.Dir)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"dupfind: %v\\n\", err)\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tentries, err := walk.Files(root, cfg.MinSize, stderr)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"dupfind: %v\\n\", err)\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tgroups := dupes.Order(dupes.GroupByDigest(root, dupes.GroupBySize(entries), stderr))\n\twrite := report.WriteListing\n\tif cfg.Summary {\n\t\twrite = report.WriteSummary\n\t}\n\tif err := write(stdout, groups); err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"dupfind: %v\\n\", err)\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// parseArgs interprets [--summary] [--min-size <bytes>] <directory>. Options must precede the\n// directory; any other positional argument counts toward the single-directory requirement.\nfunc parseArgs(args []string) (Config, error) {\n\tfs := flag.NewFlagSet(\"dupfind\", flag.ContinueOnError)\n\tfs.SetOutput(io.Discard)\n\tvar cfg Config\n\tfs.BoolVar(&cfg.Summary, \"summary\", false, \"\")\n\tminSize := fs.String(\"min-size\", \"1\", \"\")\n\tif err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {\n\t\treturn Config{}, err\n\t}\n\tif fs.NArg() != 1 {\n\t\treturn Config{}, fmt.Errorf(\"expected exactly one directory argument, got %d\", fs.NArg())\n\t}\n\tn, err := parseMinSize(*minSize)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn Config{}, err\n\t}\n\tcfg.MinSize = n\n\tcfg.Dir = fs.Arg(0)\n\treturn cfg, nil\n}\n\n// parseMinSize accepts only a string of ASCII decimal digits whose value is at least 1 and fits\n// in an int64. Signs, zero, hexadecimal, exponent forms, and overflow are rejected.\nfunc parseMinSize(s string) (int64, error) {\n\tinvalid := fmt.Errorf(\"--min-size must be a positive decimal integer, got %q\", s)\n\tif s == \"\" {\n\t\treturn 0, invalid\n\t}\n\tfor i := 0; i < len(s); i++ {\n\t\tif s[i] < '0' || s[i] > '9' {\n\t\t\treturn 0, invalid\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tn, err := strconv.ParseInt(s, 10, 64)\n\tif err != nil || n < 1 {\n\t\treturn 0, invalid\n\t}\n\treturn n, nil\n}\n\n// validateDirectory confirms that dir names an existing directory and returns its path with\n// symbolic links resolved, so that a link to a directory can be walked.\nfunc validateDirectory(dir string) (string, error) {\n\tinfo, err := os.Stat(dir)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", err\n\t}\n\tif !info.IsDir() {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"%s is not a directory\", dir)\n\t}\n\tresolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(dir)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", err\n\t}\n\treturn resolved, nil\n}\n\n// errNoDirectory is returned by parseArgs when no directory is given; kept distinct for tests.\nvar _ = errors.New\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":113,"oldLines":6,"newStart":113,"newLines":3,"lines":["   }","   return resolved, nil"," }","-","-// errNoDirectory is returned by parseArgs when no directory is given; kept distinct for tests.","-var _ = errors.New"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_011Azr6dddu5QBaa4hgxkZXT","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a9d4fcb3-5ed6-4260-a2c0-1654cde25014","uuid":"f1e27504-8a14-44af-af8d-e83dd88a0494","timestamp":"2026-10-25T17:52:35.920Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DupFind/runs/20261025.174005/build/DupFind/internal/cli/cli.go","oldString":"import (\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"flag\"","newString":"import (\n\t\"flag\"","originalFile":"// Package cli implements the dupfind command line: argument parsing, directory\n// validation, pipeline orchestration, and exit codes.\npackage cli\n\nimport (\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"flag\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"strconv\"\n\n\t\"dupfind/internal/dupes\"\n\t\"dupfind/internal/report\"\n\t\"dupfind/internal/walk\"\n)\n\n// Config is the parsed command line.\ntype Config struct {\n\tSummary bool\n\tMinSize int64\n\tDir     string\n}\n\nconst usage = \"usage: dupfind [--summary] [--min-size <bytes>] <directory>\"\n\n// Run executes dupfind with args and returns the process exit code: 0 on success,\n// 1 on operational failure, 2 on usage error. Standard output carries only CSV.\nfunc Run(args []string, stdout, stderr io.Writer) int {\n\tcfg, err := parseArgs(args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"dupfind: %v; %s\\n\", err, usage)\n\t\treturn 2\n\t}\n\troot, err := validateDirectory(cfg.Dir)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"dupfind: %v\\n\", err)\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tentries, err := walk.Files(root, cfg.MinSize, stderr)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"dupfind: %v\\n\", err)\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tgroups := dupes.Order(dupes.GroupByDigest(root, dupes.GroupBySize(entries), stderr))\n\twrite := report.WriteListing\n\tif cfg.Summary {\n\t\twrite = report.WriteSummary\n\t}\n\tif err := write(stdout, groups); err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"dupfind: %v\\n\", err)\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// parseArgs interprets [--summary] [--min-size <bytes>] <directory>. Options must precede the\n// directory; any other positional argument counts toward the single-directory requirement.\nfunc parseArgs(args []string) (Config, error) {\n\tfs := flag.NewFlagSet(\"dupfind\", flag.ContinueOnError)\n\tfs.SetOutput(io.Discard)\n\tvar cfg Config\n\tfs.BoolVar(&cfg.Summary, \"summary\", false, \"\")\n\tminSize := fs.String(\"min-size\", \"1\", \"\")\n\tif err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {\n\t\treturn Config{}, err\n\t}\n\tif fs.NArg() != 1 {\n\t\treturn Config{}, fmt.Errorf(\"expected exactly one directory argument, got %d\", fs.NArg())\n\t}\n\tn, err := parseMinSize(*minSize)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn Config{}, err\n\t}\n\tcfg.MinSize = n\n\tcfg.Dir = fs.Arg(0)\n\treturn cfg, nil\n}\n\n// parseMinSize accepts only a string of ASCII decimal digits whose value is at least 1 and fits\n// in an int64. Signs, zero, hexadecimal, exponent forms, and overflow are rejected.\nfunc parseMinSize(s string) (int64, error) {\n\tinvalid := fmt.Errorf(\"--min-size must be a positive decimal integer, got %q\", s)\n\tif s == \"\" {\n\t\treturn 0, invalid\n\t}\n\tfor i := 0; i < len(s); i++ {\n\t\tif s[i] < '0' || s[i] > '9' {\n\t\t\treturn 0, invalid\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tn, err := strconv.ParseInt(s, 10, 64)\n\tif err != nil || n < 1 {\n\t\treturn 0, invalid\n\t}\n\treturn n, nil\n}\n\n// validateDirectory confirms that dir names an existing directory and returns its path with\n// symbolic links resolved, so that a link to a directory can be walked.\nfunc validateDirectory(dir string) (string, error) {\n\tinfo, err := os.Stat(dir)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", err\n\t}\n\tif !info.IsDir() {\n\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"%s is not a directory\", dir)\n\t}\n\tresolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(dir)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", err\n\t}\n\treturn resolved, nil\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":3,"oldLines":7,"newStart":3,"newLines":6,"lines":[" package cli"," "," import (","-  \"errors\"","   \"flag\"","   \"fmt\"","   \"io\""]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01LWQnxbdksVvTcP6iRRV7Zo","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgPP6NQEhRFw1z5td5z38","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01UzEx34U9BurYxrPMYJ7pYf","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DupFind/runs/20261025.174005/build/DupFind/internal/walk/walk_test.go","content":"package walk\n\nimport (\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"reflect\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\n// writeFiles creates each named file under a fresh temporary root with the given contents.\nfunc writeFiles(t *testing.T, files map[string]string) string {\n\tt.Helper()\n\troot := t.TempDir()\n\tfor name, body := range files {\n\t\tp := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(name))\n\t\tif err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0o755); err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn root\n}\n\n// paths returns the Path of each entry in order.\nfunc paths(entries []Entry) []string {\n\tout := []string{}\n\tfor _, e := range entries {\n\t\tout = append(out, e.Path)\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// lockDir makes dir unreadable and restores its mode before the temporary directory is removed.\n// It reports false, and the caller should skip, when permissions are not enforced here.\nfunc lockDir(t *testing.T, dir string) bool {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tif err := os.Chmod(dir, 0); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tt.Cleanup(func() { os.Chmod(dir, 0o755) })\n\tif _, err := os.ReadDir(dir); err == nil {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc TestFilesReturnsNestedAndHiddenRegularFiles(t *testing.T) {\n\troot := writeFiles(t, map[string]string{\n\t\t\"top.txt\":           \"abc\",\n\t\t\"sub/deep/leaf.txt\": \"leafy\",\n\t\t\".hidden/.env\":      \"KEY=1\",\n\t})\n\n\tgot, err := Files(root, 1, &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\twant := []string{\".hidden/.env\", \"sub/deep/leaf.txt\", \"top.txt\"}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(paths(got), want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"paths = %v, want %v\", paths(got), want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestFilesReportsSizeOfEachFile(t *testing.T) {\n\troot := writeFiles(t, map[string]string{\"a\": \"abc\", \"d/b\": \"abcdef\"})\n\n\tgot, err := Files(root, 1, &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tsizes := map[string]int64{}\n\tfor _, e := range got {\n\t\tsizes[e.Path] = e.Size\n\t}\n\tif sizes[\"a\"] != 3 || sizes[\"d/b\"] != 6 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"sizes = %v, want a=3 d/b=6\", sizes)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestFilesUsesSlashSeparatedRelativePaths(t *testing.T) {\n\troot := writeFiles(t, map[string]string{\"one/two/three.txt\": \"x\"})\n\n\tgot, err := Files(root, 1, &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"one/two/three.txt\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(paths(got), want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"paths = %v, want %v\", paths(got), want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestFilesOmitsSymlinkToFile(t *testing.T) {\n\troot := writeFiles(t, map[string]string{\"real.txt\": \"content\"})\n\tif err := os.Symlink(\"real.txt\", filepath.Join(root, \"link.txt\")); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Skip(\"symbolic links not supported here:\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tgot, err := Files(root, 1, &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"real.txt\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(paths(got), want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"paths = %v, want %v\", paths(got), want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestFilesDoesNotTraverseSymlinkToDirectory(t *testing.T) {\n\troot := writeFiles(t, map[string]string{\"sub/inner.txt\": \"inner\"})\n\tif err := os.Symlink(\"sub\", filepath.Join(root, \"dirlink\")); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Skip(\"symbolic links not supported here:\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tgot, err := Files(root, 1, &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"sub/inner.txt\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(paths(got), want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"paths = %v, want %v\", paths(got), want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestFilesOmitsZeroByteFilesEvenWhenMinSizeIsZero(t *testing.T) {\n\troot := writeFiles(t, map[string]string{\"empty\": \"\", \"d/also-empty\": \"\", \"full\": \"x\"})\n\n\tgot, err := Files(root, 0, &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"full\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(paths(got), want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"paths = %v, want %v\", paths(got), want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestFilesIncludesFileExactlyAtMinSize(t *testing.T) {\n\troot := writeFiles(t, map[string]string{\"two\": \"ab\", \"three\": \"abc\"})\n\n\tgot, err := Files(root, 3, &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"three\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(paths(got), want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"paths = %v, want %v\", paths(got), want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestFilesIgnoresFilesBelowMinSize(t *testing.T) {\n\troot := writeFiles(t, map[string]string{\"one\": \"a\", \"four\": \"abcd\"})\n\n\tgot, err := Files(root, 2, &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"four\"}; err == nil {\n\t\tt.Error(\"Files on a missing root returned no error\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestFilesSkipsUnreadableSubdirectoryWithOneWarning(t *testing.T) {\n\troot := writeFiles(t, map[string]string{\"ok.txt\": \"fine\", \"locked/hidden.txt\": \"secret\"})\n\tif !lockDir(t, filepath.Join(root, \"locked\")) {\n\t\tt.Skip(\"directory permissions are not enforced here\")\n\t}\n\n\tvar warn bytes.Buffer\n\tgot, err := Files(root, 1, &warn)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Files returned error for unreadable subdirectory: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"ok.txt\"}; {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01X4QugFnYNJx1u3ZTFY3K2v","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DupFind/runs/20261025.174005/build/DupFind/internal/dupes/dupes_test.go (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a9d4fcb3-5ed6-4260-a2c0-1654cde25014","uuid":"50299c54-510e-461a-90d2-b7802269884d","timestamp":"2026-10-25T17:53:05.981Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DupFind/runs/20261025.174005/build/DupFind/internal/dupes/dupes_test.go","content":"package dupes\n\nimport (\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"crypto/sha256\"\n\t\"encoding/hex\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"reflect\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"dupfind/internal/walk\"\n)\n\n// writeFiles creates each named file under a fresh temporary root with the given contents.\nfunc writeFiles(t *testing.T, files map[string]string) string {\n\tt.Helper()\n\troot := t.TempDir()\n\tfor name, body := range files {\n\t\tp := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(name))\n\t\tif err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0o755); err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn root\n}\n\n// entriesOf builds walk entries for the named files, sizing each from its contents.\nfunc entriesOf(files map[string]string) []walk.Entry {\n\tvar out []walk.Entry\n\tfor name, body := range files {\n\t\tout = append(out, walk.Entry{Path: name, Size: int64(len(body))})\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// sha256Hex returns the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of body.\nfunc sha256Hex(body string) string {\n\tsum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(body))\n\treturn hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])\n}\n\n// bucketPaths returns the sorted paths of each bucket, with the buckets sorted by first path.\nfunc bucketPaths(buckets [][]walk.Entry) [][]string {\n\tvar out [][]string\n\tfor _, b := range buckets {\n\t\tvar ps []string\n\t\tfor _, e := range b {\n\t\t\tps = append(ps, e.Path)\n\t\t}\n\t\tout = append(out, sortedStrings(ps))\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\nfunc sortedStrings(in []string) []string {\n\tout := append([]string(nil), in...)\n\tfor i := 1; i < len(out); i++ {\n\t\tfor j := i; j > 0 && out[j] < out[j-1]; j-- {\n\t\t\tout[j], out[j-1] = out[j-1], out[j]\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// lockFile makes path unreadable and restores its mode before cleanup. It reports false, and the\n// caller should skip, when permissions are not enforced here.\nfunc lockFile(t *testing.T, path string) bool {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tif err := os.Chmod(path, 0); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tt.Cleanup(func() { os.Chmod(path, 0o644) })\n\tif f, err := os.Open(path); err == nil {\n\t\tf.Close()\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupBySizeOmitsUniqueSizes(t *testing.T) {\n\tentries := entriesOf(map[string]string{\"a\": \"xx\", \"b\": \"yyy\", \"c\": \"zzzz\"})\n\n\tif got := GroupBySize(entries); len(got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"buckets = %v, want none\", bucketPaths(got))\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupBySizeKeepsSharedSizes(t *testing.T) {\n\tentries := entriesOf(map[string]string{\n\t\t\"p\": \"aaaaa\", \"q\": \"bbbbb\",\n\t\t\"r\": \"ccccccccc\", \"s\": \"ddddddddd\", \"t\": \"eeeeeeeee\",\n\t\t\"u\": \"f\",\n\t})\n\n\tgot := bucketPaths(GroupBySize(entries))\n\twant := [][]string{{\"p\", \"q\"}, {\"r\", \"s\", \"t\"}}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"buckets = %v, want %v\", got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupBySizeEmptyInputReturnsNoBuckets(t *testing.T) {\n\tif got := GroupBySize(nil); len(got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"buckets = %v, want none\", bucketPaths(got))\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestGroupsIdenticalContents(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"a/one\": \"same\\n\", \"b/two\": \"same\\n\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\n\tgot := GroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tif len(got) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"groups = %d, want 1\", len(got))\n\t}\n\tg := got[0]\n\tif g.Size != 5 || g.Digest != sha256Hex(\"same\\n\") {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"group size/digest = %d/%s, want 5/%s\", g.Size, g.Digest, sha256Hex(\"same\\n\"))\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(sortedStrings(g.Paths), []string{\"a/one\", \"b/two\"}) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"paths = %v, want a/one and b/two\", g.Paths)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestSameSizeDifferentContentsIsNotDuplicate(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"a\": \"aaaa\", \"b\": \"bbbb\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\n\tif got := GroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &bytes.Buffer{}); !reflect.DeepEqual(sortedStrings(got[0].Paths), want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"paths = %v, want %v\", got[0].Paths, want)\n\t}\n\tif n := strings.Count(warn.String(), \"\\n\"); n != 1 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"warning lines = %d, want 1: %q\", n, warn.String())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestNeverOpensUniqueSizeFiles(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"solo\": \"unique-size\", \"twin1\": \"pair\", \"twin2\": \"pair\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\tif !lockFile(t, filepath.Join(root, \"solo\")) {\n\t\tt.Skip(\"file permissions are not enforced here\")\n\t}\n\n\tvar warn bytes.Buffer\n\tGroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &warn)\n\tif warn.Len() != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"warning written for a unique-size file: %q\", warn.String())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestDoesNotModifyFiles(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"a\": \"twin\", \"b\": \"twin\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\n\tGroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tfor name, want := range files {\n\t\tgot, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, name))\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif string(got) != want {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"%s = %q, want %q\", name, got, want)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupReclaimableForTwoAndThreeCopies(t *testing.T) {\n\ttwo := Group{Size: 10, Paths: []string{\"a\", \"b\"}}\n\tthree := Group{Size: 7, Paths: []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"}}\n\n\tif got := two.Reclaimable(); got != 10 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"two-copy reclaimable = %d, want 10\", got)\n\t}\n\tif got := three.Reclaimable(); got != 14 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"three-copy reclaimable = %d, want 14\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestOrderPutsReclaimableBytesFirst(t *testing.T) {\n\tsmall := Group{Size: 3, Digest: \"bb\", Paths: []string{\"s1\", \"s2\", \"s3\", \"s4\", \"s5\"}} // 12\n\tlarge := Group{Size: 10, Digest: \"aa\", Paths: []string{\"l1\", \"l2\"}}                  // 10\n\n\tgot := Order([]Group{large, small})\n\tif got[0].Digest != \"bb\" || got[1].Digest != \"aa\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"order = %s, %s; want bb then aa\", got[0].Digest, got[1].Digest)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestOrderBreaksReclaimableTiesByDigest(t *testing.T) {\n\tlater := Group{Size: 10, Digest: \"dd\", Paths: []string{\"a\", \"b\"}}      // 10\n\tearlier := Group{Size: 5, Digest: \"cc\", Paths: []string{\"c\", \"d\", \"e\"}} // 10\n\n\tgot := Order([]Group{later, earlier})\n\tif got[0].Digest != \"cc\" || got[1].Digest != \"dd\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"order = %s, %s; err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn root\n}\n\n// entriesOf builds walk entries for the named files, sizing each from its contents.\nfunc entriesOf(files map[string]string) []walk.Entry {\n\tvar out []walk.Entry\n\tfor name, body := range files {\n\t\tout = append(out, walk.Entry{Path: name, Size: int64(len(body))})\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// sha256Hex returns the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of body.\nfunc sha256Hex(body string) string {\n\tsum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(body))\n\treturn hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])\n}\n\n// bucketPaths returns the sorted paths of each bucket, with the buckets sorted by first path.\nfunc bucketPaths(buckets [][]walk.Entry) [][]string {\n\tvar out [][]string\n\tfor _, b := range buckets {\n\t\tvar ps []string\n\t\tfor _, e := range b {\n\t\t\tps = append(ps, e.Path)\n\t\t}\n\t\tout = append(out, sortedStrings(ps))\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\nfunc sortedStrings(in []string) []string {\n\tout := append([]string(nil), in...)\n\tfor i := 1; i < len(out); i++ {\n\t\tfor j := i; j > 0 && out[j] < out[j-1]; j-- {\n\t\t\tout[j], out[j-1] = out[j-1], out[j]\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// lockFile makes path unreadable and restores its mode before cleanup. It reports false, and the\n// caller should skip, when permissions are not enforced here.\nfunc lockFile(t *testing.T, path string) bool {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tif err := os.Chmod(path, 0); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tt.Cleanup(func() { os.Chmod(path, 0o644) })\n\tif f, err := os.Open(path); err == nil {\n\t\tf.Close()\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupBySizeOmitsUniqueSizes(t *testing.T) {\n\tentries := entriesOf(map[string]string{\"a\": \"xx\", \"b\": \"yyy\", \"c\": \"zzzz\"})\n\n\tif got := GroupBySize(entries); len(got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"buckets = %v, want none\", bucketPaths(got))\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupBySizeKeepsSharedSizes(t *testing.T) {\n\tentries := entriesOf(map[string]string{\n\t\t\"p\": \"aaaaa\", \"q\": \"bbbbb\",\n\t\t\"r\": \"ccccccccc\", \"s\": \"ddddddddd\", \"t\": \"eeeeeeeee\",\n\t\t\"u\": \"f\",\n\t})\n\n\tgot := bucketPaths(GroupBySize(entries))\n\twant := [][]string{{\"p\", \"q\"}, {\"r\", \"s\", \"t\"}}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"buckets = %v, want %v\", got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupBySizeEmptyInputReturnsNoBuckets(t *testing.T) {\n\tif got := GroupBySize(nil); len(got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"buckets = %v, want none\", bucketPaths(got))\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestGroupsIdenticalContents(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"a/one\": \"same\\n\", \"b/two\": \"same\\n\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\n\tgot := GroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tif len(got) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"groups = %d, want 1\", len(got))\n\t}\n\tg := got[0]\n\tif g.Size != 5 || g.Digest != sha256Hex(\"same\\n\") {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"group size/digest = %d/%s, want 5/%s\", g.Size, g.Digest, sha256Hex(\"same\\n\"))\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(sortedStrings(g.Paths), []string{\"a/one\", \"b/two\"}) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"paths = %v, want a/one and b/two\", g.Paths)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestSameSizeDifferentContentsIsNotDuplicate(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"a\": \"aaaa\", \"b\": \"bbbb\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\n\tif got := GroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &bytes.Buffer{}); len(got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"groups = %+v, want none\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestSplitsSameSizeIntoSeparateGroups(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"x1\": \"abcd\", \"x2\": \"abcd\", \"y1\": \"abce\", \"y2\": \"abce\", \"z1\": \"abcf\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\n\tgot := GroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tif len(got) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"groups = %d, want 2\", len(got))\n\t}\n\tbyDigest := map[string][]string{}\n\tfor _, g := range got {\n\t\tbyDigest[g.Digest] = sortedStrings(g.Paths)\n\t}\n\twant := map[string][]string{\n\t\tsha256Hex(\"abcd\"): {\"x1\", \"x2\"},\n\t\tsha256Hex(\"abce\"): {\"y1\", \"y2\"},\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(byDigest, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"groups = %v, want %v\", byDigest, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestSkipsUnreadableWithOneWarning(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"ok1\": \"same\", \"ok2\": \"same\", \"locked\": \"same\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\tif !lockFile(t, filepath.Join(root, \"locked\")) {\n\t\tt.Skip(\"file permissions are not enforced here\")\n\t}\n\n\tvar warn bytes.Buffer\n\tgot := GroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &warn)\n\tif len(got) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"groups = %d, want 1\", len(got))\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"ok1\", \"ok2\"}; got != 10 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"two-copy reclaimable = %d, want 10\", got)\n\t}\n\tif got := three.Reclaimable(); got != 14 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"three-copy reclaimable = %d, want 14\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestOrderPutsReclaimableBytesFirst(t *testing.T) {\n\tsmall := Group{Size: 3, Digest: \"bb\", Paths: []string{\"s1\", \"s2\", \"s3\", \"s4\", \"s5\"}} // 12\n\tlarge := Group{Size: 10, Digest: \"aa\", Paths: []string{\"l1\", \"l2\"}}                  // 10\n\n\tgot := Order([]Group{large, small})\n\tif got[0].Digest != \"bb\" || got[1].Digest != \"aa\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"order = %s, %s; err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn root\n}\n\n// entriesOf builds walk entries for the named files, sizing each from its contents.\nfunc entriesOf(files map[string]string) []walk.Entry {\n\tvar out []walk.Entry\n\tfor name, body := range files {\n\t\tout = append(out, walk.Entry{Path: name, Size: int64(len(body))})\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// sha256Hex returns the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of body.\nfunc sha256Hex(body string) string {\n\tsum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(body))\n\treturn hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])\n}\n\n// bucketPaths returns the sorted paths of each bucket, with the buckets sorted by first path.\nfunc bucketPaths(buckets [][]walk.Entry) [][]string {\n\tvar out [][]string\n\tfor _, b := range buckets {\n\t\tvar ps []string\n\t\tfor _, e := range b {\n\t\t\tps = append(ps, e.Path)\n\t\t}\n\t\tout = append(out, sortedStrings(ps))\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// sortedStrings returns a sorted copy of in.\nfunc sortedStrings(in []string) []string {\n\tout := append([]string(nil), in...)\n\tsort.Strings(out)\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// lockFile makes path unreadable and restores its mode before cleanup. It reports false, and the\n// caller should skip, when permissions are not enforced here.\nfunc lockFile(t *testing.T, path string) bool {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tif err := os.Chmod(path, 0); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tt.Cleanup(func() { os.Chmod(path, 0o644) })\n\tif f, err := os.Open(path); err == nil {\n\t\tf.Close()\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupBySizeOmitsUniqueSizes(t *testing.T) {\n\tentries := entriesOf(map[string]string{\"a\": \"xx\", \"b\": \"yyy\", \"c\": \"zzzz\"})\n\n\tif got := GroupBySize(entries); len(got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"buckets = %v, want none\", bucketPaths(got))\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupBySizeKeepsSharedSizes(t *testing.T) {\n\tentries := entriesOf(map[string]string{\n\t\t\"p\": \"aaaaa\", \"q\": \"bbbbb\",\n\t\t\"r\": \"ccccccccc\", \"s\": \"ddddddddd\", \"t\": \"eeeeeeeee\",\n\t\t\"u\": \"f\",\n\t})\n\n\tgot := bucketPaths(GroupBySize(entries))\n\twant := [][]string{{\"p\", \"q\"}, {\"r\", \"s\", \"t\"}}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"buckets = %v, want %v\", got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupBySizeEmptyInputReturnsNoBuckets(t *testing.T) {\n\tif got := GroupBySize(nil); len(got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"buckets = %v, want none\", bucketPaths(got))\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestGroupsIdenticalContents(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"a/one\": \"same\\n\", \"b/two\": \"same\\n\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\n\tgot := GroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tif len(got) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"groups = %d, want 1\", len(got))\n\t}\n\tg := got[0]\n\tif g.Size != 5 || g.Digest != sha256Hex(\"same\\n\") {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"group size/digest = %d/%s, want 5/%s\", g.Size, g.Digest, sha256Hex(\"same\\n\"))\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(sortedStrings(g.Paths), []string{\"a/one\", \"b/two\"}) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"paths = %v, want a/one and b/two\", g.Paths)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestSameSizeDifferentContentsIsNotDuplicate(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"a\": \"aaaa\", \"b\": \"bbbb\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\n\tif got := GroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &bytes.Buffer{}); len(got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"groups = %+v, want none\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestSplitsSameSizeIntoSeparateGroups(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"x1\": \"abcd\", \"x2\": \"abcd\", \"y1\": \"abce\", \"y2\": \"abce\", \"z1\": \"abcf\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\n\tgot := GroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tif len(got) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"groups = %d, want 2\", len(got))\n\t}\n\tbyDigest := map[string][]string{}\n\tfor _, g := range got {\n\t\tbyDigest[g.Digest] = sortedStrings(g.Paths)\n\t}\n\twant := map[string][]string{\n\t\tsha256Hex(\"abcd\"): {\"x1\", \"x2\"},\n\t\tsha256Hex(\"abce\"): {\"y1\", \"y2\"},\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(byDigest, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"groups = %v, want %v\", byDigest, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestSkipsUnreadableWithOneWarning(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"ok1\": \"same\", \"ok2\": \"same\", \"locked\": \"same\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\tif !lockFile(t, filepath.Join(root, \"locked\")) {\n\t\tt.Skip(\"file permissions are not enforced here\")\n\t}\n\n\tvar warn bytes.Buffer\n\tgot := GroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &warn)\n\tif len(got) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"groups = %d, want 1\", len(got))\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"ok1\", \"ok2\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(sortedStrings(got[0].Paths), want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"paths = %v, want %v\", got[0].Paths, want)\n\t}\n\tif n := strings.Count(warn.String(), \"\\n\"); n != 1 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"warning lines = %d, want 1: %q\", n, warn.String())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestNeverOpensUniqueSizeFiles(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"solo\": \"unique-size\", \"twin1\": \"pair\", \"twin2\": \"pair\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\tif !lockFile(t, filepath.Join(root, \"solo\")) {\n\t\tt.Skip(\"file permissions are not enforced here\")\n\t}\n\n\tvar warn bytes.Buffer\n\tGroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &warn)\n\tif warn.Len() != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"warning written for a unique-size file: %q\", warn.String())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestDoesNotModifyFiles(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"a\": \"twin\", \"b\": \"twin\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\n\tGroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tfor name, want := range files {\n\t\tgot, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, name))\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif string(got) != want {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"%s = %q, want %q\", name, got, want)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupReclaimableForTwoAndThreeCopies(t *testing.T) {\n\ttwo := Group{Size: 10, Paths: []string{\"a\", \"b\"}}\n\tthree := Group{Size: 7, Paths: []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"}}\n\n\tif got := two.Reclaimable(); got != 10 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"two-copy reclaimable = %d, want 10\", got)\n\t}\n\tif got := three.Reclaimable(); got != 14 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"three-copy reclaimable = %d, want 14\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestOrderPutsReclaimableBytesFirst(t *testing.T) {\n\tsmall := Group{Size: 3, Digest: \"bb\", Paths: []string{\"s1\", \"s2\", \"s3\", \"s4\", \"s5\"}} // 12\n\tlarge := Group{Size: 10, Digest: \"aa\", Paths: []string{\"l1\", \"l2\"}}                  // 10\n\n\tgot := Order([]Group{large, small})\n\tif got[0].Digest != \"bb\" || got[1].Digest != \"aa\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"order = %s, %s; want bb then aa\", got[0].Digest, got[1].Digest)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestOrderBreaksReclaimableTiesByDigest(t *testing.T) {\n\tlater := Group{Size: 10, Digest: \"dd\", Paths: []string{\"a\", \"b\"}}      // 10\n\tearlier := Group{Size: 5, Digest: \"cc\", Paths: []string{\"c\", \"d\", \"e\"}} // 10\n\n\tgot := Order([]Group{later, earlier})\n\tif got[0].Digest != \"cc\" || got[1].Digest != \"dd\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"order = %s, %s; want cc then dd\", got[0].Digest, got[1].Digest)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestOrderSortsPathsByByteValue(t *testing.T) {\n\tg := Group{Size: 1, Digest: \"x\", Paths: []string{\"b.txt\", \"B.txt\", \"a b.txt\", \"a/z.txt\", \".hid/x.txt\", \"a.txt\"}}\n\n\tgot := Order([]Group{g})\n\twant := []string{\".hid/x.txt\", \"B.txt\", \"a b.txt\", \"a.txt\", \"a/z.txt\", \"b.txt\"}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(got[0].Paths, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"paths = %v, want %v\", got[0].Paths, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestOrderNumbersGroupsFromOne(t *testing.T) {\n\tgroups := []Group{\n\t\t{Size: 1, Digest: \"a\", Paths: []string{\"p\", \"q\"}},\n\t\t{Size: 2, Digest: \"b\", Paths: []string{\"r\", \"s\"}},\n\t\t{Size: 3, Digest: \"c\", Paths: []string{\"t\", \"u\"}},\n\t}\n\n\tgot := Order(groups)\n\tfor i, g := range got {\n\t\tif g.Number != i+1 {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"group %d number = %d, want %d\", i, g.Number, i+1)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestOrderEmptyReturnsEmpty(t *testing.T) {\n\tif got := Order(nil); len(got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"order = %v, want empty\", got)\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":7,"oldLines":6,"newStart":7,"newLines":7,"lines":["   \"os\"","   \"path/filepath\"","   \"reflect\"","+  \"sort\"","   \"strings\"","   \"testing\""," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01NTkKnyirvt2hWSGYhKiiFJ","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\n\tgot := parseCSV(t, buf.String())\n\twant := [][]string{\n\t\t{\"group\", \"size\", \"sha256\", \"path\"},\n\t\t{\"1\", \"10\", \"d1\", \"a/one\"},\n\t\t{\"1\", \"10\", \"d1\", \"b/two\"},\n\t\t{\"1\", \"10\", \"d1\", \"c/three\"},\n\t\t{\"2\", \"4\", \"d2\", \"x\"},\n\t\t{\"2\", \"4\", \"d2\", \"y\"},\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"listing = %v, want %v\", got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestWriteListingWithNoGroupsWritesHeaderOnly(t *testing.T) {\n\tvar buf bytes.Buffer\n\tif err := WriteListing(&buf, nil); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\n\tgot := parseCSV(t, buf.String())\n\tif want := [][]string{{\"group\", \"size\", \"sha256\", \"path\"}}; !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"listing = %v, want %v\", got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestWriteListingUsesLFLineEndings(t *testing.T) {\n\tvar buf bytes.Buffer\n\tif err := WriteListing(&buf, sampleGroups()); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tif bytes.Contains(buf.Bytes(), []byte(\"\\r\")) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"listing contains carriage return: %q\", buf.String())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestWriteListingQuotesCommaAndQuoteInPaths(t *testing.T) {\n\tpaths := []string{\"song,live.mp3\", `say \"hi\".txt`, \"plain.txt\"}\n\tgroups := []dupes.Group{{Number: 1, Size: 8, Digest: \"d\", Paths: paths}}\n\n\tvar buf bytes.Buffer\n\tif err := WriteListing(&buf, groups); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\n\tgot := parseCSV(t, buf.String())\n\twant := [][]string{\n\t\t{\"groups\", \"duplicate_files\", \"reclaimable_bytes\"},\n\t\t{\"2\", \"3\", \"24\"}, // 10*2 + 4*1 reclaimable; 2 + 1 duplicate files\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"summary = %v, want %v\", got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestWriteSummaryNoGroupsIsZeroRow(t *testing.T) {\n\tvar buf bytes.Buffer\n\tif err := WriteSummary(&buf, nil); {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Fx1oUk5ydwc7Jpq3LC2eeX","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DupFind/runs/20261025.174005/build/DupFind/internal/dupes/dupes_test.go has been updated successfully. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a9d4fcb3-5ed6-4260-a2c0-1654cde25014","uuid":"1d554a73-260d-4c38-a3ea-c001ad61a5d7","timestamp":"2026-10-25T17:53:24.131Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DupFind/runs/20261025.174005/build/DupFind/internal/dupes/dupes_test.go","oldString":"func TestGroupByDigestGroupsIdenticalContents(t *testing.T) {","newString":"func TestGroupByDigest(t *testing.T) {","originalFile":"package dupes\n\nimport (\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"crypto/sha256\"\n\t\"encoding/hex\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"reflect\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"dupfind/internal/walk\"\n)\n\n// writeFiles creates each named file under a fresh temporary root with the given contents.\nfunc writeFiles(t *testing.T, files map[string]string) string {\n\tt.Helper()\n\troot := t.TempDir()\n\tfor name, body := range files {\n\t\tp := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(name))\n\t\tif err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0o755); err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn root\n}\n\n// entriesOf builds walk entries for the named files, sizing each from its contents.\nfunc entriesOf(files map[string]string) []walk.Entry {\n\tvar out []walk.Entry\n\tfor name, body := range files {\n\t\tout = append(out, walk.Entry{Path: name, Size: int64(len(body))})\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// sha256Hex returns the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of body.\nfunc sha256Hex(body string) string {\n\tsum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(body))\n\treturn hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])\n}\n\n// bucketPaths returns the sorted paths of each bucket, with the buckets sorted by first path.\nfunc bucketPaths(buckets [][]walk.Entry) [][]string {\n\tvar out [][]string\n\tfor _, b := range buckets {\n\t\tvar ps []string\n\t\tfor _, e := range b {\n\t\t\tps = append(ps, e.Path)\n\t\t}\n\t\tout = append(out, sortedStrings(ps))\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// sortedStrings returns a sorted copy of in.\nfunc sortedStrings(in []string) []string {\n\tout := append([]string(nil), in...)\n\tsort.Strings(out)\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// lockFile makes path unreadable and restores its mode before cleanup. It reports false, and the\n// caller should skip, when permissions are not enforced here.\nfunc lockFile(t *testing.T, path string) bool {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tif err := os.Chmod(path, 0); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tt.Cleanup(func() { os.Chmod(path, 0o644) })\n\tif f, err := os.Open(path); err == nil {\n\t\tf.Close()\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupBySizeOmitsUniqueSizes(t *testing.T) {\n\tentries := entriesOf(map[string]string{\"a\": \"xx\", \"b\": \"yyy\", \"c\": \"zzzz\"})\n\n\tif got := GroupBySize(entries); len(got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"buckets = %v, want none\", bucketPaths(got))\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupBySizeKeepsSharedSizes(t *testing.T) {\n\tentries := entriesOf(map[string]string{\n\t\t\"p\": \"aaaaa\", \"q\": \"bbbbb\",\n\t\t\"r\": \"ccccccccc\", \"s\": \"ddddddddd\", \"t\": \"eeeeeeeee\",\n\t\t\"u\": \"f\",\n\t})\n\n\tgot := bucketPaths(GroupBySize(entries))\n\twant := [][]string{{\"p\", \"q\"}, {\"r\", \"s\", \"t\"}}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"buckets = %v, want %v\", got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupBySizeEmptyInputReturnsNoBuckets(t *testing.T) {\n\tif got := GroupBySize(nil); len(got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"buckets = %v, want none\", bucketPaths(got))\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestGroupsIdenticalContents(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"a/one\": \"same\\n\", \"b/two\": \"same\\n\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\n\tgot := GroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tif len(got) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"groups = %d, want 1\", len(got))\n\t}\n\tg := got[0]\n\tif g.Size != 5 || g.Digest != sha256Hex(\"same\\n\") {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"group size/digest = %d/%s, want 5/%s\", g.Size, g.Digest, sha256Hex(\"same\\n\"))\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(sortedStrings(g.Paths), []string{\"a/one\", \"b/two\"}) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"paths = %v, want a/one and b/two\", g.Paths)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestSameSizeDifferentContentsIsNotDuplicate(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"a\": \"aaaa\", \"b\": \"bbbb\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\n\tif got := GroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &bytes.Buffer{}); len(got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"groups = %+v, want none\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestSplitsSameSizeIntoSeparateGroups(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"x1\": \"abcd\", \"x2\": \"abcd\", \"y1\": \"abce\", \"y2\": \"abce\", \"z1\": \"abcf\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\n\tgot := GroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tif len(got) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"groups = %d, want 2\", len(got))\n\t}\n\tbyDigest := map[string][]string{}\n\tfor _, g := range got {\n\t\tbyDigest[g.Digest] = sortedStrings(g.Paths)\n\t}\n\twant := map[string][]string{\n\t\tsha256Hex(\"abcd\"): {\"x1\", \"x2\"},\n\t\tsha256Hex(\"abce\"): {\"y1\", \"y2\"},\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(byDigest, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"groups = %v, want %v\", byDigest, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestSkipsUnreadableWithOneWarning(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"ok1\": \"same\", \"ok2\": \"same\", \"locked\": \"same\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\tif !lockFile(t, filepath.Join(root, \"locked\")) {\n\t\tt.Skip(\"file permissions are not enforced here\")\n\t}\n\n\tvar warn bytes.Buffer\n\tgot := GroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &warn)\n\tif len(got) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"groups = %d, want 1\", len(got))\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"ok1\", \"ok2\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(sortedStrings(got[0].Paths), want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"paths = %v, want %v\", got[0].Paths, want)\n\t}\n\tif n := strings.Count(warn.String(), \"\\n\"); n != 1 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"warning lines = %d, want 1: %q\", n, warn.String())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestNeverOpensUniqueSizeFiles(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"solo\": \"unique-size\", \"twin1\": \"pair\", \"twin2\": \"pair\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\tif !lockFile(t, filepath.Join(root, \"solo\")) {\n\t\tt.Skip(\"file permissions are not enforced here\")\n\t}\n\n\tvar warn bytes.Buffer\n\tGroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &warn)\n\tif warn.Len() != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"warning written for a unique-size file: %q\", warn.String())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestDoesNotModifyFiles(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"a\": \"twin\", \"b\": \"twin\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\n\tGroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tfor name, want := range files {\n\t\tgot, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, name))\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif string(got) != want {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"%s = %q, want %q\", name, got, want)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupReclaimableForTwoAndThreeCopies(t *testing.T) {\n\ttwo := Group{Size: 10, Paths: []string{\"a\", \"b\"}}\n\tthree := Group{Size: 7, Paths: []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"}}\n\n\tif got := two.Reclaimable(); got != 10 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"two-copy reclaimable = %d, want 10\", got)\n\t}\n\tif got := three.Reclaimable(); got != 14 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"three-copy reclaimable = %d, want 14\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestOrderPutsReclaimableBytesFirst(t *testing.T) {\n\tsmall := Group{Size: 3, Digest: \"bb\", Paths: []string{\"s1\", \"s2\", \"s3\", \"s4\", \"s5\"}} // 12\n\tlarge := Group{Size: 10, Digest: \"aa\", Paths: []string{\"l1\", \"l2\"}}                  // 10\n\n\tgot := Order([]Group{large, small})\n\tif got[0].Digest != \"bb\" || got[1].Digest != \"aa\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"order = %s, %s; err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn root\n}\n\n// entriesOf builds walk entries for the named files, sizing each from its contents.\nfunc entriesOf(files map[string]string) []walk.Entry {\n\tvar out []walk.Entry\n\tfor name, body := range files {\n\t\tout = append(out, walk.Entry{Path: name, Size: int64(len(body))})\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// sha256Hex returns the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of body.\nfunc sha256Hex(body string) string {\n\tsum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(body))\n\treturn hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])\n}\n\n// bucketPaths returns the sorted paths of each bucket, with the buckets sorted by first path.\nfunc bucketPaths(buckets [][]walk.Entry) [][]string {\n\tvar out [][]string\n\tfor _, b := range buckets {\n\t\tvar ps []string\n\t\tfor _, e := range b {\n\t\t\tps = append(ps, e.Path)\n\t\t}\n\t\tout = append(out, sortedStrings(ps))\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// sortedStrings returns a sorted copy of in.\nfunc sortedStrings(in []string) []string {\n\tout := append([]string(nil), in...)\n\tsort.Strings(out)\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// lockFile makes path unreadable and restores its mode before cleanup. It reports false, and the\n// caller should skip, when permissions are not enforced here.\nfunc lockFile(t *testing.T, path string) bool {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tif err := os.Chmod(path, 0); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tt.Cleanup(func() { os.Chmod(path, 0o644) })\n\tif f, err := os.Open(path); err == nil {\n\t\tf.Close()\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupBySizeOmitsUniqueSizes(t *testing.T) {\n\tentries := entriesOf(map[string]string{\"a\": \"xx\", \"b\": \"yyy\", \"c\": \"zzzz\"})\n\n\tif got := GroupBySize(entries); len(got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"buckets = %v, want none\", bucketPaths(got))\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupBySizeKeepsSharedSizes(t *testing.T) {\n\tentries := entriesOf(map[string]string{\n\t\t\"p\": \"aaaaa\", \"q\": \"bbbbb\",\n\t\t\"r\": \"ccccccccc\", \"s\": \"ddddddddd\", \"t\": \"eeeeeeeee\",\n\t\t\"u\": \"f\",\n\t})\n\n\tgot := bucketPaths(GroupBySize(entries))\n\twant := [][]string{{\"p\", \"q\"}, {\"r\", \"s\", \"t\"}}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"buckets = %v, want %v\", got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupBySizeEmptyInputReturnsNoBuckets(t *testing.T) {\n\tif got := GroupBySize(nil); range files {\n\t\tp := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(name))\n\t\tif err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0o755); err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn root\n}\n\n// entriesOf builds walk entries for the named files, sizing each from its contents.\nfunc entriesOf(files map[string]string) []walk.Entry {\n\tvar out []walk.Entry\n\tfor name, body := range files {\n\t\tout = append(out, walk.Entry{Path: name, Size: int64(len(body))})\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// sha256Hex returns the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of body.\nfunc sha256Hex(body string) string {\n\tsum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(body))\n\treturn hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])\n}\n\n// bucketPaths returns the sorted paths of each bucket, with the buckets sorted by first path.\nfunc bucketPaths(buckets [][]walk.Entry) [][]string {\n\tvar out [][]string\n\tfor _, b := range buckets {\n\t\tvar ps []string\n\t\tfor _, e := range b {\n\t\t\tps = append(ps, e.Path)\n\t\t}\n\t\tout = append(out, sortedStrings(ps))\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// sortedStrings returns a sorted copy of in.\nfunc sortedStrings(in []string) []string {\n\tout := append([]string(nil), in...)\n\tsort.Strings(out)\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// lockFile makes path unreadable and restores its mode before cleanup. It reports false, and the\n// caller should skip, when permissions are not enforced here.\nfunc lockFile(t *testing.T, path string) bool {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tif err := os.Chmod(path, 0); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tt.Cleanup(func() { os.Chmod(path, 0o644) })\n\tif f, err := os.Open(path); err == nil {\n\t\tf.Close()\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupBySizeOmitsUniqueSizes(t *testing.T) {\n\tentries := entriesOf(map[string]string{\"a\": \"xx\", \"b\": \"yyy\", \"c\": \"zzzz\"})\n\n\tif got := GroupBySize(entries); len(got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"buckets = %v, want none\", bucketPaths(got))\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupBySizeKeepsSharedSizes(t *testing.T) {\n\tentries := entriesOf(map[string]string{\n\t\t\"p\": \"aaaaa\", \"q\": \"bbbbb\",\n\t\t\"r\": \"ccccccccc\", \"s\": \"ddddddddd\", \"t\": \"eeeeeeeee\",\n\t\t\"u\": \"f\",\n\t})\n\n\tgot := bucketPaths(GroupBySize(entries))\n\twant := [][]string{{\"p\", \"q\"}, {\"r\", \"s\", \"t\"}}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"buckets = %v, want %v\", got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupBySizeEmptyInputReturnsNoBuckets(t *testing.T) {\n\tif got := GroupBySize(nil); len(got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"buckets = %v, want none\", bucketPaths(got))\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigest(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"a/one\": \"same\\n\", \"b/two\": \"same\\n\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\n\tgot := GroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tif len(got) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"groups = %d, want 1\", len(got))\n\t}\n\tg := got[0]\n\tif g.Size != 5 || g.Digest != sha256Hex(\"same\\n\") {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"group size/digest = %d/%s, want 5/%s\", g.Size, g.Digest, sha256Hex(\"same\\n\"))\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(sortedStrings(g.Paths), []string{\"a/one\", \"b/two\"}) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"paths = %v, want a/one and b/two\", g.Paths)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestSameSizeDifferentContentsIsNotDuplicate(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"a\": \"aaaa\", \"b\": \"bbbb\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\n\tif got := GroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &bytes.Buffer{}); len(got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"groups = %+v, want none\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestSplitsSameSizeIntoSeparateGroups(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"x1\": \"abcd\", \"x2\": \"abcd\", \"y1\": \"abce\", \"y2\": \"abce\", \"z1\": \"abcf\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\n\tgot := GroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tif len(got) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"groups = %d, want 2\", len(got))\n\t}\n\tbyDigest := map[string][]string{}\n\tfor _, g := range got {\n\t\tbyDigest[g.Digest] = sortedStrings(g.Paths)\n\t}\n\twant := map[string][]string{\n\t\tsha256Hex(\"abcd\"): {\"x1\", \"x2\"},\n\t\tsha256Hex(\"abce\"): {\"y1\", \"y2\"},\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(byDigest, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"groups = %v, want %v\", byDigest, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestSkipsUnreadable(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"ok1\": \"same\", \"ok2\": \"same\", \"locked\": \"same\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\tif !lockFile(t, filepath.Join(root, \"locked\")) {\n\t\tt.Skip(\"file permissions are not enforced here\")\n\t}\n\n\tvar warn bytes.Buffer\n\tgot := GroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &warn)\n\tif len(got) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"groups = %d, want 1\", len(got))\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"ok1\", \"ok2\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(sortedStrings(got[0].Paths), want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"paths = %v, want %v\", got[0].Paths, want)\n\t}\n\tif n := strings.Count(warn.String(), \"\\n\"); n != 1 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"warning lines = %d, want 1: %q\", n, warn.String())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestNeverOpensUniqueSizeFiles(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"solo\": \"unique-size\", \"twin1\": \"pair\", \"twin2\": \"pair\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\tif !lockFile(t, filepath.Join(root, \"solo\")) {\n\t\tt.Skip(\"file permissions are not enforced here\")\n\t}\n\n\tvar warn bytes.Buffer\n\tGroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &warn)\n\tif warn.Len() != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"warning written for a unique-size file: %q\", warn.String())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupByDigestDoesNotModifyFiles(t *testing.T) {\n\tfiles := map[string]string{\"a\": \"twin\", \"b\": \"twin\"}\n\troot := writeFiles(t, files)\n\n\tGroupByDigest(root, GroupBySize(entriesOf(files)), &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tfor name, want := range files {\n\t\tgot, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, name))\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif string(got) != want {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"%s = %q, want %q\", name, got, want)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestGroupReclaimableForTwoAndThreeCopies(t *testing.T) {\n\ttwo := Group{Size: 10, Paths: []string{\"a\", \"b\"}}\n\tthree := Group{Size: 7, Paths: []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"}}\n\n\tif got := two.Reclaimable(); got != 10 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"two-copy reclaimable = %d, want 10\", got)\n\t}\n\tif got := three.Reclaimable(); got != 14 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"three-copy reclaimable = %d, want 14\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestOrderPutsReclaimableBytesFirst(t *testing.T) {\n\tsmall := Group{Size: 3, Digest: \"bb\", Paths: []string{\"s1\", \"s2\", \"s3\", \"s4\", \"s5\"}} // 12\n\tlarge := Group{Size: 10, Digest: \"aa\", Paths: []string{\"l1\", \"l2\"}}                  // 10\n\n\tgot := Order([]Group{large, small})\n\tif got[0].Digest != \"bb\" || got[1].Digest != \"aa\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"order = %s, %s;
